unit: Power: Monarchy and Democracy in Britain c.1000-2014
title: Pressure groups, Thatcher and challenges to Parliament

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of CND, Greenpeace and the Miners' Strike — non-party pressure challenging Parliament after 1980.

items.title: Thatcher Vs The Miners: The Propaganda War That Ended The Strikes | Miners' Strike
items.description: Channel 4 documentary on the 1984-85 miners' strike — how Thatcher and the NUM fought for control of British industry. 50 min.

items.title: Thatcher and the 1984 Miners' Strike | GCSE Power and the People
items.description: GCSE-focused overview of the miners' strike and Thatcher's challenge to trade union power — directly exam-relevant. 8 min.

items.title: Pride (2014)
items.description: LGBTQ+ activists supporting the miners' strike — the unlikely alliance that shows pressure groups at their most creative.

items.title: The Iron Lady (2011)
items.description: Meryl Streep as Thatcher — the PM who reshaped British politics and took on Parliament's relationship with the trade unions.

items.title: The Full Monty (1997)
items.description: Sheffield steelworkers in the post-miners'-strike era — the human cost of Thatcher's challenge to industrial Britain.

items.title: Parliament UK — Teaching Resources
items.description: Parliament UK resources on pressure groups, protest and democracy — including post-1980 political challenges.
